content:
**New River Red Ale** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A red-colored ale brewed using Bloodleaf and Razorgrain. It increases Strength and Charisma by one while also lowering Intelligence by one. It shares its appearance with a standard beer bottle, but has a New River label featuring a man on an inner tube on the river under the New River Gorge Bridge.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, New River Red Ale is initially crafted as fermentable New River Red Ale, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly higher disease chance of 9% until fully fermented.

New River Red Ale can be crafted using a Brewing Station, part of the brewing and distilling functionality of *Wild Appalachia*.
